claim_binding.revision_semantics: Deterministic 40-hex review-pack fingerprint, not source proof and not required to be a Git commit.
claim_binding.scope_semantics: Canonical A coordination scope derived from normalized route id; compatible with a-session-scope-policy.

session_isolation: A B/C/D reviewer should normally request its own session. ANY is allowed for coordination inspection only.
stale_guard: After claim acquisition, re-read the queue. If status or review_revision changed, SUPERSEDE the stale claim using the same stable owner and continue.
decision_boundary: Allocator creates ownership only. It never writes REVIEWING, DECIDED, ADOPTED, HOLD, REJECTED or SUPERSEDED receiver decisions.
owner_policy: Stable A-session owner identity is mandatory and one_live_claim_per_owner applies. A busy owner cannot allocate a second review until completion/abandon/supersede or lease expiry.
